mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_evaluation WHERE interview_id = #{interviewId} ORDER BY question_index ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_questions, AVG(ai_score) as avg_score, SUM(CASE WHEN ai_level = '优秀' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as proficient_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ai_level IN ('一般', '较差') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as weak_count FROM t_evaluation WHERE interview_id = #{interviewId}
